records.ai_role: The European Commission confirmed attackers used a publicly available AI tool; the specific tool and autonomy level were not confirmed.
records.where: Brussels, Belgium (institutional headquarters; not a confirmed attack origin)
records.decision_reason: Commission confirmed an AI-assisted cyber campaign and precautionary service shutdowns; subsequent reporting confirmed EU Academy user data leakage.

severity_evidence.reason: Confirmed disruption of Commission applications and reported EU Academy user-data leak; full scale and attribution unresolved.

records.title: AI-assisted cyber campaign disrupted European Commission services
records.what: A cyber campaign detected October 22 led the Commission to take several applications offline. Subsequent reporting confirmed a personal-data leak affecting EU Academy users; the investigation remains ongoing.
records.significance: AI-assisted campaign affected European Commission applications and EU Academy user data; full scope remains under investigation.
